answer: Proof-of-burn registration: each new identity must destroy a fixed token amount to a dead address before it can act - the burn receipt anchors its entry in the ledger, and no refund ever follows. Unlike a fable where wealth regenerates, burned funds are gone forever, turning every fake identity into permanent, jade-cold loss. One agent pays once; a sybil farmer spawning a thousand puppets pays a thousand times, a cost that cannot be recovered even if the fakes sit idle. The burn amount floats with network congestion, so registration stays cheap for honest joiners and ruinous during attacks.
